sentences.en: You shouldn't live merely in pursuit of your own happiness.
sentences.zh: 你 shouldn't 生活仅仅为了追求自己的幸福。

sentences.en: What happened to life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness?
sentences.zh: 生活、自由和追求幸福发生了什么？

sentences.en: He was interested in only the pursuit of wealth.
sentences.zh: 他 只对追求财富 感兴趣。

senses.zh: 追求，寻求；追赶，追捕；职业，事业
